output.role: raw-screenshot | annotated-screenshot | receipt-strip | chart | diagram | checklist | teardown-crop | stat-card | meme | lo-fi-photo | generated-scene
output.mobile_read: What must be readable at phone feed size.

reference_images.role: base screenshot | style reference | logo | product | photo
reference_images.use: What to take from this image.
reference_images.allowed_changes: crop, blur, annotate, recolor, place, or none

render_data.chart_data: Exact values, axis labels, dates and units when the role is chart.

main_visual.type: screenshot | UI crop | email or DM receipt | chart | diagram | stat card | photo | scene
main_visual.description: What is visibly in the image, not why the post exists.
main_visual.state_or_action: What the object, person or UI is doing or showing.

composition.framing: tight crop | medium shot | full object | top down | three quarter | isometric
composition.angle: eye level | low angle | high angle | top down | straight on | slight handheld tilt
composition.layout: Placement, spacing, hierarchy, negative space, safe areas.
composition.annotation_plan: Arrow, circle, highlight, blur or callout placement, if any.
composition.scroll_stop: The visible element that makes someone pause before reading the post.

camera_and_light.camera_style: phone screenshot | phone photo | documentary photo | clean editorial graphic | flat diagram
camera_and_light.lens_or_view: 50mm candid | 35mm documentary | top down phone shot | orthographic or isometric diagram | not applicable
camera_and_light.depth_of_field: none | deep focus | shallow background blur
camera_and_light.lighting: window light | screen glow | overcast daylight | flat even diagram light | soft studio
camera_and_light.texture: screen pixels, paper grain, compression, slight blur, imperfect crop, or none

style.medium: raw screenshot | annotated screenshot | simple diagram | stat card | photo
style.polish_level: raw | lightly cleaned | branded but restrained

brand.logo_use: none | small corner mark | preserve from reference image

text_elements.position: top left | center | callout label | beside arrow | none
text_elements.typography: large bold sans | handwritten annotation | small UI label
text_elements.rules: Include only this text, exactly once. No other captions.

constraints: No invented numbers, labels, logos, UI states, testimonials or customers.
